text:
alex.m: quick ping — PR #31872 (https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/31872) is green except flaky mac e2e. Need to land before Fri blackout. Is there a short rebase window tonight (00:30-01:30 UTC)? Can we run a canary? @priya @jordan

priya: I can do a canary if we have a slot. Are you expecting any DB migrations? :thinking:

alex.m: no migrations, only a small telemetry change. plan is to land and monitor. canary would be enough.

jordan: I can trigger a focused mac matrix rerun and watch. If it passes, thumbs up to land in the rebase window. what's the branch? run locally: ```gha rerun --pr 31872 --job mac-e2e```

ci-bot: ci-bot: queued rerun for PR 31872 job mac-e2e — build 4521. status: running

jordan: heads-up, those flakes are timing-sensitive. if it fails again we can try a tiny no-op rebase to bust the cache.

priya: Agreed. If canary passes i'll add a note in the release queue and approve. Otherwise we hold until Saturday morning.

ci-bot: ci-bot: build 4521 passed ✅

alex.m: great — i'll land during the 00:45 UTC window and tag canary. thanks y'all :pray: 

jordan: eyes will be on logs after landing.
